Common.tagline: From idea to plate, with AI.

Home.metaDescription: Culinova creates your recipes with AI: weighed to the gram, costed, illustrated and ready to publish. Free access by invitation.
Home.intro: Create, cost, illustrate and manage your recipes. Free access, by invitation, during this first phase.

hero.eyebrow: By invitation · free during the pilot phase
hero.lead: Describe a craving, a few ingredients or a dish name: Culinova writes a recipe weighed to the gram, works out its cost and selling price, imagines the plating and turns it into a photo ready to publish.
hero.sampleName: Seared salmon, vinegared rice and radish pickles

pillars.title: The whole journey, from idea to plate
pillars.lead: One tool to create, cost, illustrate and organise your cooking.

items.title: Create
items.text: Moment, culinary influence, country, style: the AI builds a real recipe, weighed to the gram, with clear steps and a described plating.

items.title: Illustrate
items.text: A realistic photo based on the plating, in four formats for Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest and your website.

items.title: Cost
items.text: Ingredient, labour and energy cost per portion, suggested price excl. and incl. VAT, margins. Prices update from a scanned invoice.

items.title: Manage
items.text: Library, versions, homemade preparations, menus, shopping lists, stock and printable technical sheets.

items.title: Publish
items.text: Instagram and Pinterest copy and a TikTok script written for each recipe, without repetition, following the real steps.

steps.title: You set the tone
steps.text: A moment (main, snack, street food…), an influence, a style, the number of people, and your idea or ingredients.

steps.title: The AI cooks up the recipe
steps.text: Weighed ingredients, precise steps, real timings, plating, nutrition facts and allergens. Regenerate it or change it in one sentence.

steps.title: You bring it to life
steps.text: Photo, selling price, technical sheet, cooking mode with timers, shopping list and social media content.

gallery.title: Made with Culinova
gallery.lead: Recipes and photos generated with the app, unretouched.

items.a: Nothing during the pilot phase. Culinova is free, by invitation. If paid plans arrive later, you will be told in advance and nothing will be charged without your consent.

items.q: How do I get an invitation?
items.a: Fill in the form above. Every request is read; if it is accepted, you receive a personal code by email and a link to create your account in a minute.
No. You sign in with a link sent by email, valid for 15 minutes and usable only once.
They are weighed to the gram and checked (every ingredient used, complete steps). You stay in control: every price, analysis or translation suggested by the AI is yours to approve.
It is hosted in the European Union, never sold and never used to train models. You can export it or delete your account at any time.

items.q: Can I use it on my phone?
items.a: Yes. Culinova installs like an app from your browser (“Add to Home Screen”), ideal for cooking mode in the kitchen.
